messages:
anya: quick note: global continuous-batcher p99.9 spikes again this morning, looks correlated with 2 noisy tenants.
sam: saw that. thinking about small tenant islands to isolate noisy tenants. downside: KV cache fragmentation and cold warmup.
ricardo: ran a tiny sim (4 islands): throughput -2%, p95 -10%, p99 -20%, but cold-batch latency jumped ~80ms median for islands.
anya: rough hybrid: hot islands for top 20% latency-sensitive tenants, global pool for the rest. route by tenant-priority + short traffic fingerprint.
sam: need headroom ledger so islands can borrow and repay. otherwise islands hoard slots and starve global.
ricardo: agree. propose borrow_limit = 0.15*gpuslots per island, repay when recent_rps falls below baseline.
anya: eviction strategy: stream hot KV prefixes to a shared warm cache before evicting. avoids huge recompute.
sam: metrics to add: per-island kv_hit_ratio_1m, cold_batch_latency_1m, island_borrow_balance. alert if cold_batch_latency > 120ms.
infra-bot: canary-deploy: continuous-batcher/hybrid-islands v0.1 deployed to 2 nodes. traces: /infra/batcher/canary/1794440000 after ingestion (~3m).
anya: plan: 1) 50k-trace replay global vs island vs hybrid (measure p50/p95/p99/p99.9 + cost), 2) headroom ledger prototype, 3) shared-warm-cache microtest.
sam: i can run the replay today. ricardo will prototype ledger. anya will build simple warm-cache.
ricardo: quick risk list: GPU memory increase due to KV replication, rollout complexity, edge-case starvation. mitigation: quantized KV, strict borrow caps, phased canary.
anya: if sim reduces p99.9 meaningfully with <5% cost, proceed. posting numbers back here.
sam: thanks all, starting the replay now.
ricardo: instrumenting per-island metrics in canary now.
